definitions.explanation: A principle or reference point used for comparison, judgment, or measurement.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たしている。
どのような{基準|きじゅん}で{選|えら}んだのですか。
examples.english: Based on what criteria did you select it?

examples.japanese: この{基準|きじゅん}に{基|もと}づいて{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: We will judge based on this standard.

notes:
{基準|きじゅん} refers to standards or criteria used for evaluation or reference.

Common collocations:
- {基準|きじゅん}を{設|もう}ける (to establish standards)
- {基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たす (to meet standards)
- {基準|きじゅん}に{達|たっ}する (to reach the standard)
- {判断|はんだん}{基準|きじゅん} (criteria for judgment)
- {安全|あんぜん}{基準|きじゅん} (safety standards)

Related terms:
- {規準|きじゅん} (alternative kanji, same meaning)
- {標準|ひょうじゅん} (standard - more about norms)
- {規格|きかく} (specifications, standards - often technical)
- {目安|めやす} (guideline, rough standard)
